newsitem.title: CROATIA: Two Raiffeisenbank Croatia directors resign - agency.
newsitem.headline: Two Raiffeisenbank Croatia directors resign - agency.

text.p: Two directors of the Croatian subsidiary of Austria's Raiffeisenbank (RBA) resigned over disagreements on how to run the bank, Croatian news agency HINA reported on Wednesday.
It said the "significant differences in views" arose during the last joint session of RBA's supervisory and management boards.
No one at the bank was immediately available for comment.

HINA said Zdenko Adrovic, who recently joined RBA's managing board from local Privredna Banka, and the current deputy board member, Michael Mueller, would be in charge until the supervisory board appointed new directors.
RBA doubled its capital to 30 million German marks in May with a view to expanding operations in Croatia and servicing larger clients. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
